name: Light Leak
source:
There's a mysterious well hidden in the woods. Something terrible happened here. For some reason a girl becomes attached to this place.

[From [url=https://wandeer.itch.io/light-leak]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
树林里隐藏着一口神秘的井。这里发生了可怕的事情。由于某种原因，一个女孩对这个地方产生了依恋。
